name: EducationUSA Scholars Program (ESP)
sponsor: U.S. Department of State / U.S. Embassy Addis Ababa
eligibility: Academically talented Ethiopian high-school students
Selected by U.S. Embassy Addis
intl_notes: Free preparatory program (TOEFL, SAT, application essays, college search) — not direct funding, but the single highest-leverage Ethiopia-specific resource. Email AddisAbaba@EducationUSA.org.

name: Lettie Pate Whitehead Foundation
eligibility: Christian women
Studying at one of ~200 partner schools in AL, FL, GA, LA, MS, NC, SC, TN, VA
Demonstrated financial need
intl_notes: Awarded through partner schools — first apply to one of the partner colleges (the foundation publishes the list), then the school nominates you.

name: AACN Scholarships & Financial Aid Hub
sponsor: American Association of Colleges of Nursing
eligibility: Nursing students of all levels
intl_notes: Curated list of nursing-specific scholarships — eligibility varies by award. Some are open to international students.

name: Global Scholarship Alliance
eligibility: International registered nurses pursuing US graduate nursing study
intl_notes: Focused on RNs from abroad pursuing graduate nursing in the US — useful to bookmark for the future MSN step, less relevant for a first BSN.

name: BridgeWay Nursing Scholarship
eligibility: International students pursuing a master's in nursing in the US
Specializations: Gerontology, Clinical Nurse Leadership, Health Informatics, Nursing Education
intl_notes: Fully funded (tuition + living). Master's-level only — bookmark for after BSN.

name: National Black Nurses Association Scholarships
eligibility: Black/African nursing students at all levels (LPN through Doctorate)
NBNA member
intl_notes: Requires US enrollment and NBNA membership; African applicants are welcome but you must already be a US student.

name: Alexis G. Philius Scholarship
eligibility: 5 Black/African healthcare students per year
intl_notes: Awarded to students enrolled in US programs; check union eligibility rules.

name: Rotary Foundation Global Grants
eligibility: Graduate-level study only (master's)
Aligned with one of Rotary's areas of focus (incl. disease prevention)
Must be sponsored by your home Rotary club AND a host Rotary club
intl_notes: Significant funding source for graduate study — relevant later for MSN. Find a Rotary club in Addis Ababa now and start the relationship early.

name: AAUW International Fellowships
eligibility: Women pursuing full-time graduate or post-doctoral study in the US
Not a US citizen or permanent resident
intl_notes: Graduate-level only — relevant for the MSN/DNP step, not the initial BSN.

name: P.E.O. International Peace Scholarship
eligibility: Women international students pursuing graduate study in US or Canada
Not US/Canadian citizens
intl_notes: Graduate-only. Bookmark for MSN.

name: MMEG Education Grants
eligibility: Women from a developing country (Ethiopia eligible)
Pursuing study in the US, Canada, or other approved regions
Committed to improving the lives of women and children in home country
intl_notes: Graduate-focused but check current cycle; nursing applicants are competitive given the women-and-children mission alignment.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (Ethiopia)
sponsor: U.S. Department of State (Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs)
eligibility: Ethiopian citizens
Graduate study (Master's or PhD) in the US
Strong academic record and English proficiency
intl_notes: Fully funded but graduate-level only. Bookmark for after BSN. Contact EducationUSA Addis for current cycle dates.

name: Church of the Brethren Health Care Education Scholarship
eligibility: Active Church of the Brethren member
Pursuing a healthcare-related degree (incl. nursing)
intl_notes: Members only — niche but listed because Brethren churches do exist in East Africa.

name: Andrews University Distinguished International Scholarship
eligibility: International undergraduate students with strong academics
Adventist or non-Adventist applicants both welcome
intl_notes: Tiered merit aid; renewable based on GPA. One of the most consistent intl-friendly aid programs in the Adventist system.

name: Slippery Rock University International Undergraduate Scholarship
eligibility: New international undergraduates
No need requirement; renewable with 3.0+ GPA
intl_notes: All admitted international undergrads receive some aid automatically; better aid with higher GPA.

name: UIC College of Nursing International Student Scholarship
sponsor: University of Illinois Chicago, College of Nursing
eligibility: Current intl UIC students in the undergraduate BSN program
Minimum 3.5 cumulative GPA at UIC
intl_notes: You must first be admitted and enrolled, then earn the GPA. Apply to UIC first, plan to apply for this in year 2.

name: ETSU International Student Award
eligibility: F-1 or J-1 visa
3.0 GPA (or international equivalent)
intl_notes: ETSU is one of the publics that has explicit nursing-eligible international scholarships.

name: John Brown University International Aid
eligibility: International undergraduate students
Strong academics; Christian-mission alignment helpful
intl_notes: JBU is known for substantial merit aid for international Christian students — often the practical winner on cost-after-aid for applicants from the developing world.

name: Harvard Financial Aid (need-blind, full need)
eligibility: Admitted Harvard undergraduates
Need demonstrated via CSS Profile and family financial statement
intl_notes: Need-blind for international students; if admitted with full need, attendance can be essentially free. Same policy applies at MIT, Yale, Princeton, Amherst.

name: MPOWER Financing (no-cosigner intl loans)
eligibility: Admitted to one of 50+ partner US/Canadian schools
Underwritten on academic + future earning potential — no cosigner, no collateral
intl_notes: Fixed-rate loan, monthly interest-only payments while in school. Use as last resort to close a funding gap, not as a primary plan.

name: Prodigy Finance (no-cosigner intl loans)
eligibility: Admitted to one of 1800+ supported schools globally
Underwritten without collateral or cosigner
intl_notes: Mostly graduate-focused but check current undergraduate eligibility.

name: Nurses Christian Fellowship Scholarship Directory
eligibility: Christian nursing students
intl_notes: Not a single award — a directory of Christian nursing scholarships and a list of accredited Christian nursing schools. Useful starting point.

name: Tylenol Future Care Scholarship
eligibility: Currently enrolled at a US college pursuing a healthcare-related degree
Applicants must be US residents — confirm intl status before applying
intl_notes: Listed for completeness — typically US residents only. Skip unless eligibility changes.

name: Nurse Corps Scholarship Program (HRSA)
sponsor: U.S. Health Resources and Services Administration
eligibility: U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, or lawful permanent residents
Enrolled in accredited US nursing school
intl_notes: Listed only to flag clearly: this is one of the biggest nursing scholarships in the US, but it is closed to F-1 students. Worth bookmarking if status ever changes.

name: Bold.org Nursing Scholarships (database)
eligibility: Varies per award
intl_notes: Bold.org aggregates 120+ nursing-specific scholarships; filter to those that accept international applicants. Free account.

name: Fastweb Nursing Scholarships (database)
eligibility: Varies per award
intl_notes: Largest US scholarship database. Profile-match nursing scholarships; many US-only but the filtering saves time.

name: NurseJournal — Nursing Scholarships for International Students (database)
eligibility: Varies per award
intl_notes: Curated list specifically of nursing scholarships open to international students. Strong starting point.

name: Hot Courses Abroad — Nursing Scholarships USA (database)
eligibility: Varies per award
intl_notes: 300+ nursing scholarships listed for US study by an international-students-focused aggregator.
